component.name: MatrixPlayer
component.summary: Audio-focused music player for local collections

description.p: MatrixPlayer plays local music collections through a native GStreamer pipeline with 64-bit float processing, straight into PipeWire.

ul.li: Gapless playback, ReplayGain with clipping prevention, and soft fades
Parametric and graphic equalizer with presets, tone and stereo controls
A fast library of albums, artists, genres and folders with instant search
Playlists, favorites, listening history and a reorderable queue
Synced lyrics, spectrum and level visualizers, and a waveform seek bar
Media keys and desktop controls through MPRIS
